label: fl-studio-mcp
description: karl-andres/fl-studio-mcp — control FL Studio (transport, mixer, channels, plugins, piano roll) from Claude via a loopMIDI bridge and an FL Studio controller script. Needs loopMIDI installed manually first (https://www.tobias-erichsen.de/software/loopmidi.html, create a virtual port, keep it running) and, after this step, a one-time manual FL Studio config: restart FL Studio, Options > MIDI Settings, select the loopMIDI port, set Controller type to FLStudioMCP, enable the port

installs.shell: if not exist "%USERPROFILE%\.local\fl-studio-mcp" git clone https://github.com/karl-andres/fl-studio-mcp.git "%USERPROFILE%\.local\fl-studio-mcp" && cd /d "%USERPROFILE%\.local\fl-studio-mcp" && uv sync --python 3.12 && if not exist "%USERPROFILE%\Documents\Image-Line\FL Studio\Settings\Hardware\FLStudioMCP" mkdir "%USERPROFILE%\Documents\Image-Line\FL Studio\Settings\Hardware\FLStudioMCP" && copy /y fl_controller\device_FLStudioMCP.py "%USERPROFILE%\Documents\Image-Line\FL Studio\Settings\Hardware\FLStudioMCP\" && copy /y scripts\ComposeWithLLM.pyscript "%USERPROFILE%\Documents\Image-Line\FL Studio\Settings\Piano roll scripts\" && claude mcp add -s user fl-studio -- uv run --directory "%USERPROFILE%\.local\fl-studio-mcp" fl-studio-mcp

label: musescore-mcp
description: ghchen99/mcp-musescore — WebSocket-based MuseScore control from Claude: compose notes/rests, add lyrics, navigate/select score, manage measures, LilyPond-mapped polyphony. Needs a one-time manual step in MuseScore first: Plugins > Plugin Manager > enable 'MuseScore API Server' (the .qml this installs into the Plugins folder), then with a score open, Plugins > MuseScore API Server before the Python server can connect (WebSocket on port 8765) — https://github.com/ghchen99/mcp-musescore

installs.shell: if not exist "%USERPROFILE%\.local\mcp-musescore" git clone https://github.com/ghchen99/mcp-musescore.git "%USERPROFILE%\.local\mcp-musescore" && cd /d "%USERPROFILE%\.local\mcp-musescore" && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt && if not exist "%USERPROFILE%\Documents\MuseScore4\Plugins" mkdir "%USERPROFILE%\Documents\MuseScore4\Plugins" && copy /y musescore-mcp-websocket.qml "%USERPROFILE%\Documents\MuseScore4\Plugins\" && claude mcp add -s user musescore -- "%USERPROFILE%\.local\mcp-musescore\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" "%USERPROFILE%\.local\mcp-musescore\server.py"
